description: Work with fonts: list the fonts used in the document or installed (family, style, type, status, variable axes), replace one font with another throughout the document and its styles (Type > Find Font), rescan font folders for missing fonts, or recompose every story

action.description: list fonts; replace a font; update_missing rescans font folders (Update missing font list); recompose recomposes all stories

from.description: For replace: the font to replace, as "Family\tStyle" or a family (every style)

includeStyles.description: For replace: also change paragraph and character styles that use the font

maxFonts.description: For list: the most fonts to return

missingOnly.description: For list: only fonts that are not installed, substituted or fauxed

nameContains.description: For list: only fonts whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

scope.description: For list: fonts used in the active document, or every installed font

to.description: For replace: the replacement, as "Family\tStyle" or a family (keeps each style)

name: manage_fonts
title: Manage Fonts
